description: This file defines the MiddlewareDispatcher class for the Slim Framework, managing middleware stack operations such as adding middleware, handling requests, and resolving middleware classes or callables.

classes.name: MiddlewareDispatcher
classes.description: Implements middleware stack management for the Slim Framework, allowing addition and resolution of middleware components, and request handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the middleware dispatcher with a kernel, optional callable resolver, and container.

methods.name: seedMiddlewareStack
methods.description: Sets the initial middleware request handler (kernel) for the stack.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Invokes the middleware stack to handle an incoming server request.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds middleware to the stack, accepting objects, class names, or callables.

methods.name: addMiddleware
methods.description: Adds a MiddlewareInterface object to the stack.

methods.name: addDeferred
methods.description: Adds middleware by class name, resolving it at runtime.

methods.name: addCallable
methods.description: Adds a callable middleware to the stack.
